posts.preview: The Parliamentary Standing Committee on Gender Equality, Health and Social Welfare is conducting an oversight mission in the Omusati region under the leadership of Hon. Ephraim Tuhadeleni Nekongo, Deputy Chairperson

The mission assesses HIV, SRHR, and GBV services for adolescents and young people, identifies barriers such as stigma and discrimination, and aims to strengthen parliamentary oversight to improve equitable, youth-friendly healthcare in Namibia

This morning the committee paid the courtesy visit at the Regional Governor Honorable Immanuel and the Regional Council Leadership before proceeding with its assessment at various clinics starting with Omahenene Clinic then proceed to Eunda Clinic See less
